correctness.rationale: Riemann--Hurwitz forces genus 4. The Riemann existence theorem reduces isomorphism classes to C9-orbits on 8064 admissible 9-cycles. Character theory gives exactly 8064 identity fixed points; the centralizer C3 wreath S3 yields exactly 9 fixed by order-3 elements; exactly 3 powers survive order-9 fixed points. Burnside gives 900. The exhaustive standard-library checker explicitly covers all 40320 cyclic orders and confirms the partition into 895, 2, 3 cover classes with deck orders 1, 3, 9. This is a finite, complete certificate of the exact finite assertion.

value.rationale: The first degree beyond the 2026 paper's complete degree-at-most-seven classification is explicitly left with an interval of 896 to 8064 unweighted covers; this determines the sharp integer 900 and every symmetry stratum. The two noncyclic order-three cases explain the entire gap between the known mass and unweighted orbit count. These are natural central moduli-count and deck-symmetry invariants of extremal Belyi maps, not arbitrary parameter slices.
